pa_server.label: PulseAudio server address
pa_server.description: PulseAudio server socket or TCP address (e.g. unix:/run/audio/pulse.sock). Leave empty to auto-detect.

source_name.label: PulseAudio source
source_name.description: Specific PulseAudio source to expose. Leave empty to show all hardware inputs. Monitor sources are also selectable here for loopback capture.

display_name.label: Display name
display_name.description: Friendly name shown in the Music Assistant UI. Overrides the PA source description when set.

sample_rate.label: Sample rate (Hz)
sample_rate.description: Capture sample rate. Auto reads the source's native rate.

bit_depth.label: Bit depth
bit_depth.description: Capture bit depth. Auto reads the source's native depth. 32-bit sources stream as PCM; 16-bit as FLAC.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: Number of audio channels. Auto reads from the source.

include_monitors.label: Include monitor sources
include_monitors.description: When enabled, sink monitor sources (loopbacks of audio outputs) also appear in the browse view, enabling capture of any output stream.
